headline: Greenwich+Docklands international festival – in pictures
context: A selection from the dozens of outdoor art performances that made up the Greenwich+Docklands international festival, which finished on Sunday. The theme was We Move – a celebration of the resilience of Londoners facing the challenges of city life Continue reading...
